class.name: InterDVDTitleSet
class.brief_description: One Video Title Set under an [InterDVDDisc].
class.description: Groups [InterDVDTitle] children and non-title [InterDVDMenuPage] children into [code]VTS_NN_*[/code]. VMGM title menus stay direct children of [InterDVDDisc]. Titles not under a set compile as VTS 1.

method.name: add_root_menu
method.description: Appends a VTSM root menu for this title set.

method.name: add_title
method.description: Appends a title in this title set.
